answer.reason: The verses tell of the lampstand being made of beaten gold, and of its being set in the tent and its lamps lit, which are its chief events.

clauses.english: was made of one piece of beaten pure gold, with six branches and seven lamps
clauses.quote: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold

clauses.english: was set in the tent on the south side and its lamps were lit before the LORD
clauses.quote: he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation

doubts: The clause about the making rests on the report of its construction in EXO 37 rather than the command in EXO 25, since the command only describes what was to be done.
Verses from EXO 25 to NUM 4, HEB 9 only list the lampstand with other furnishings or give instructions, so were not used.
